width.text: Very narrow: surgical, for one ringing frequency.

templates.bell_zero: Sits at 0 dB around {freq} ({zone}). Drag it up or down to hear what lives here.
templates.lowcut: Removes everything below {freq}, at {slope} dB per octave.
templates.highcut: Removes everything above {freq}, at {slope} dB per octave.
templates.notch: Removes a thin slice at {freq}. Use it for hum or one ringing note.
templates.bandpass: Keeps only the region around {freq}. Mostly for effects or listening.
templates.tilt: Tilts the whole sound {brighter|darker} around {freq}: highs {up|down} {half} dB, lows {down|up} {half} dB.
templates.allpass: Shifts phase around {freq} without changing the level. An advanced tool; you usually won't need it.
templates.dyn_above_cut: Cuts up to {range} around {freq} ({zone}) when {detector} gets louder than {thresh} dB. Moving {activity}% of the time.
templates.dyn_above_boost: Boosts up to {range} around {freq} ({zone}) when {detector} gets louder than {thresh} dB. Moving {activity}% of the time.
templates.dyn_below_boost: Boosts up to {range} around {freq} ({zone}) when {detector} drops below {thresh} dB. Moving {activity}% of the time.
templates.dyn_below_cut: Cuts up to {range} around {freq} ({zone}) when {detector} drops below {thresh} dB. Moving {activity}% of the time.
templates.activity_none: Not moving yet: the threshold may be too high.
templates.activity_always: Almost always moving: it's acting like a normal EQ.
